hc_conversion.scope: Weight conversion statistics only, not logits error or semantic equivalence.

q2-cache-pair.method: Four independent paired process blocks; per-process pooled request latency; two-sided Student-t on log ratio, df=3. Semantic quality is reviewed separately.

hc-confirm.method: Four independent paired process blocks; per-process pooled request latency; two-sided Student-t on log ratio, df=3. Semantic quality is reviewed separately.
